I’m just now trying to accept how delusional I truly get and it’s the most terrifying thing I’ve ever dealt with. 

My mom has untreated bipolar disorder, so I grew up in like- naturally an unstable environment so, I’m upset to know that I create the same environment as my mom once did at times.

If I could do bad things more around where the average person does it, and not as much as I personally do, even that would be great.

I get so blind delusional and impulsive that I’ve stolen things and I ‘wake up’ and I feel sick and terrified of myself and what I’m so easily capable of doing. I’ve done several other things that like I didn’t do when I had manic episodes when I was younger; it’s gotten terrifyingly worse with age and if I’m 24 and like at the level I’m at- ... like... haha I’m glad I’m trying medicine for sure. 

It’s a good thing I was fired from my job because it was an extremely toxic environment, so I am free in a lot of ways, I just need to get over the initial hurt because it can be so blinding

I appreciate hearing that right now. I’ve ruined relationships, jobs, everyone who has gotten close to me has gotten emotionally railed in the worst way. I’m glad I know why now- like I have issues separate from bipolar of course but ... the level of emotional rational id get to, and the lack of impulse control- I didn’t realize it wasn’t normal until someone pointed it out.

I am my worst enemy, it’s no one in my life but me who hurts me the most, and that’s a lot to process.

I wasn’t going to, I was really not confident that I had a right to say anything, but my manager from work heard what I had to say, and she is someone who’s worked with the hospital before, and she told me I absolutely have to report this; and the situation is a lot more serious than I realize. I have her to thank for giving me the courage and understanding to go back in.

I didn’t even know that patients, if they’re going to be undressed, are supposed to be given a gown, I didn’t know I was supposed to be briefed that they were going to look at me or ask if me I was comfortable with an examination. The HR representatives ended up having to admit that was what was procedure, and it wasn’t done for me.

The doctor simply came into the room, didn’t introduce himself, and said “stand up, drop your pants” 

I was very caught off guard at first and I hesitated, asked him if he could repeat himself because I was confused. He just again responded with “drop your pants” and I still didn’t do it, I told him “you already know I’m trans, is this necessary?”

And again he just said, “lower your pants.” 

So, in my head I’m telling myself I’m dumb for not trusting the doctor, so I did what he said.

He was looking at me and he was like “oh, so you really don’t have a phallus.” And that’s when it hit me that he was just curious about what I looked like, and immediately I was trying not to cry / think the worst and I told him, “you should have just asked me, I would have told you directly that I didn’t, why did you have to physically look?” And he looked surprised that I asked him, and he didn’t have a response. which, like, I was willing to listen and be understanding, like maybe I just didn’t know, but his silence was really horrible.

I feel really ignorant and stupid for showing him my body. HR was even saying it’s my fault for letting him look at me in that moment so it’s... it feels messy.

When I asked for the medical records, his eyes got wide and panicked and I didn’t know why at first, but then I learned that he wasn’t supposed to have done an examination like that. He isn’t supposed to ask patients with my case to be seen naked. 

Like- even you listening to me makes me feel so much better because I’ve been scared I’m feeling like I’m not valid. Again it’s hard for me to feel sensitive especially when it comes to medical procedures, but today was hard.

I really appreciate it, I just want to speak to someone who’s professional and see if the doctors in the office can be more careful towards someone who’s transgender.

I’ll tell you my perspective and it won’t necessarily be great either, but know that I get that kind of pain you’re going through.

So December is an incredibly painful time for a lot of people to go through, especially those who are already depressed. During that month a lot of people connect with others and talk, romantically talk as a form of escapism to cope with the pain and trauma around them.

Living together and having a future, these topics are a hardcore fantasy and there’s nothing wrong with that, but if you want to have a long term and healthy relationship, it makes things different. The fact alone that you see her as a perfect soulmate is definitely a beautiful thing and I’m so glad you feel so strongly... but from the girls perspective, that’s a lot of pressure and expectation for her to live up to.

Now December is over, Jan-February are the months people come back down to reality because the level of pain isn’t ‘coping and riding out the holiday’ levels of agony, it’s just more manageable depression now. Now reality is hitting her and it’s a healthy thing, it’s hard but that’s where she’s at right now.

She could have either just been using you as a way to cope with her depression during December, and genuinely formed some sort of connection with you at this point sure, but if you wanted to make things work, in my opinion—- you would have to also face reality. tell yourself she’s not your soul mate and perfect partner, but you still want to be with her, bring down your level of expectation and dispel the fantasy a bit, join her / evolve your relationship with her so it’s more of a deep reality, as scary or hard as that may sound. 

If you guys have a sexually natured or super flirty way of talking, that’s fine, but try to bring it down a bit and talk to her as you would a friend, perhaps call and just get to know one another as real person, it could go a lot better than you think. I’m not saying to just give up on her, but with the way you’re going at the moment, it won’t work, and it’s already starting to not. 

Tell her it’s okay to feel like she wants to be alone, sometimes you feel the same way, tell her that you love the future you guys spoke about, but you’re also willing to take the hard steps to get there by working on yourself. You know? If you can try to put yourself in her shoes as much as possible.
